limitations: Watchlist and hypothetical sizing only; no executable quote, broker order or live readiness.
Provider-adjusted historical prices and a current selected universe are retrospective, not point-in-time membership or an untouched holdout.
Scores rank one fixed technical rule; they are not expected returns or profit probabilities.
Historical provider closes may be split-adjusted. Whole-share affordability in these diagnostics does not reconstruct pre-split share prices or historical tradability.
ATR is an adjusted-price range proxy scaled to the latest provider close; its risk distance is not a guaranteed stop execution price.
One selection per declared exposure group does not establish correlation diversification.
Stock selection only; ETF benchmarks do not change reserved ETF holdings. Options are not evaluated.
Equal-weight candidate cohort returns; not a cash/holdings portfolio or Nautilus backtest.
Cohorts missing any declared stock's required selection history or a selected entry/exit observation are incomplete and excluded from performance summaries.
Entry uses the next exchange session CLOSE; exit is five sessions after entry. A fixed 20 basis-point round-trip cost, stressed at 40, is subtracted from returns.
Cash cohorts earn zero in their own currency; no FX conversion or cash interest is modeled.
No compounding, CAGR or Sharpe is inferred from cohort averages; this is exposed historical data.

Uses a constant illustrative post-conversion USD budget for each cohort; FX funding costs reduce that budget once. Cohort returns exclude conversion fees, subscriptions, repatriation costs and changes in CAD/USD value.
